connector.name: Seo Stack MCP
connector.registryDescription: The complete open-source SEO data stack for AI agents: 7 sources, 86 tools, one MCP server
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package seo-stack-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the raffaele86 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to a Google service-account JSON key (enables GSC + GA4)

env.name: SEO_STACK_OAUTH_CLIENT
env.description: Path to a Google OAuth desktop client secrets JSON (alternative to service account)

env.name: ADSENSE_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: AdSense account (accounts/pub-XXXX...) — enables AdSense tools on top of the Google credentials

env.name: ADSENSE_CURRENCY
env.description: Reporting currency for AdSense tools (default USD)

env.name: BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY
env.description: Bing Webmaster Tools API key (enables Bing tools)

env.name: CLARITY_API_TOKEN
env.description: Microsoft Clarity Data Export API token (enables Clarity tools)

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
env.description: Google Ads developer token (enables Keyword Planner tools; needs the google-ads extra)

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Google Ads OAuth refresh token (adwords scope)

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
env.description: Manager account id, if the customer is under an MCC

env.name: OPENPAGERANK_API_KEY
env.description: Open PageRank API key (enables the pagerank_score tool)
